subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing source emission point is clear, but the event name, reason taxonomy, privacy/cardinality policy, and whether this is a child span or parent `sessions_spawn` annotation are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add Subagent Terminal Event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it through diagnostics-otel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate Spawn Span Only
options.body: Attach failure information to the parent `sessions_spawn` tool span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths that occur after the spawn tool has returned.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Work
options.body: Defer this to broader subagent lifecycle reliability work, leaving downstream death clustering blind until that larger design lands.

recommendation.title: Add Subagent Terminal Event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it through diagnostics-otel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest source-history signal is ownership of the subagent registry lifecycle files where terminal state originates.
